effect_groups.effect: Original survive ten turns quest and Latorvius complete nine reward domain; reuse seven existing rewards, implement real Time Warp and Crystal Core dependencies.

record.name: 走进失落之城
record.text: 任务：存活10个回合。奖励：拉特维厄斯，城市之眼。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.

record.name: 拉特维厄斯，城市之眼
record.text: 战吼：随机获取2张勇闯安戈洛的任务奖励。将其余奖励洗入你的牌库。
record.text_en: [x]Battlecry: Get 2 random 'Journey to Un'Goro' Quest Rewards. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

record.name: 时空扭曲
record.text: 获得一个额外回合。（每局对战限一次）
record.text_en: Take an extra turn. (Once per game)

record.name: 水晶核心
record.text: 在本局对战的剩余时间内，你的所有随从变为5/5。
record.text_en: For the rest of the game, your minions are 5/5.

record.name: “践踏者”班纳布斯
record.text: 战吼：使你牌库中所有随从的法力值消耗减为（0）点。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of minions in your deck to (0).

record.name: 卡纳莎女王
record.text: 突袭。战吼：将20张迅猛龙牌洗入你的牌库。
record.text_en: Rush Battlecry: Shuffle 20 Raptors into your deck.

record.name: 嘉沃顿
record.text: 战吼： 连续进化五次。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Adapt 5 times.

record.name: 希望守护者阿玛拉
record.text: 嘲讽，战吼： 将你英雄的生命值变为40。
record.text_en: [x]Taunt Battlecry: Set your hero's Health to 40.

record.name: 老鲨嘴
record.text: 战吼：用随机鱼人牌填满你的手牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Fill your hand with random Murlocs.

record.name: 虚空传送门
record.text: 打开一座会永久召唤3/2小鬼的传送门。
record.text_en: Open a permanent portal that summons 3/2 Imps.

record.name: 萨弗拉斯
record.text: 战吼：你的英雄技能变为“随机对一个敌人造成8点伤害”。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Your Hero Power becomes 'Deal 8_damage to a random enemy.'

record.name: 卡纳莎的族群
record.text: 战吼：抽一张牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Draw a card.

record.name: 虚空传送门
record.text: 在你的回合结束时，召唤两个3/2的小鬼。
record.text_en: At the end of your turn, summon two 3/2 Imps.

record.name: 死吧，虫子！
record.text: 随机对一个敌人造成$8点伤害。
record.text_en: Deal $8 damage to a random enemy.

record.name: 打开时空之门
record.text: 任务：施放8个你的套牌之外的 法术。 奖励：时空扭曲。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Cast 8 spells that didn't start in your deck. Reward: Time Warp.

record.name: 探索地下洞穴
record.text: 任务：使用四张名称相同的随从牌。 奖励：水晶核心。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Play four minions with the same name. Reward: Crystal Core.

record.name: 丛林巨兽
record.text: 任务：召唤4个攻击力大于或等于5的随从。 奖励：班纳布斯。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Summon 4 minions with 5 or more Attack. Reward: Barnabus.

record.name: 拉卡利献祭
record.text: 任务：弃掉六张牌。 奖励：虚空传送门。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Discard 6 cards. Reward: Nether Portal.

record.name: 湿地女王
record.text: 任务：使用七张法力值消耗为（1）的随从牌。 奖励：卡纳莎女王。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Play seven 1-Cost minions. Reward: Queen Carnassa.

record.name: 火羽之心
record.text: 任务：使用七张具有嘲讽的随从牌。 奖励：萨弗拉斯。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Play 7 Taunt minions. Reward: Sulfuras.

record.name: 唤醒造物者
record.text: 任务：召唤6个亡语随从。奖励：希望守护者阿玛拉。
record.text_en: Quest: Summon 6 Deathrattle minions. Reward: Amara, Warden of Hope.

record.name: 鱼人总动员
record.text: 任务：召唤8个鱼人。 奖励：老鲨嘴。
record.text_en: [x]Quest: Summon 8 Murlocs. Reward: Megafin.

record.name: 最后的水晶龙
record.text: 任务：对你的随从施放5个法术。 奖励：嘉沃顿。
record.text_en: Quest: Cast 5 spells on your minions. Reward: Galvadon.

face.name: 走进失落之城
face.text: 任务：存活10个回合。奖励：拉特维厄斯，城市之眼。
face.flavorText: 第8天。成功了！入夜时分，我们走到一处发光的隧道，入口只有两个瞌睡的托维尔人看守。我们悄悄走过隧道，直接来到了失落之城的核心地带！同胞们一定会用温暖的怀抱迎接我们。

face.name: Enter the Lost City
face.text: Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.
face.flavorText: Day 8. We’ve done it! As night fell, we came upon a brilliantly glowing tunnel guarded by two slumbering Tol’vir. With silent footsteps, we walked through and emerged into the heart of the Lost City! I’m sure my people will welcome us with open arms.

implementation_policy: Actual subsequent turn_started events for either player; private fixed 2/7 split of all nine original UnGoro rewards; persistent base layer plus one-time board reset. Precise timing/lifecycle remains CN-pending.
